scenarios.title: Review an async C# method
scenarios.expectedOutput: Issues and corrected C# code; used as context only.

scenarios.title: Design a resilient .NET API client
scenarios.prompt: Sketch a small .NET 10 service method that calls a JSON HTTP endpoint with cancellation, a finite timeout, status checking, and deserialization. State how errors should be surfaced. Avoid third-party libraries.
scenarios.expectedOutput: A concise, compilable C# example and notes; context only.

scenarios.title: Diagnose a MAUI binding issue
scenarios.prompt: A compiled MAUI XAML binding displays no value, while the view model property is populated. Give a short diagnostic sequence covering x:DataType, binding paths, notification, and build diagnostics. Do not assume the framework version.

scenarios.title: Transform a typed record collection
scenarios.prompt: Write a TypeScript function that accepts readonly user records, filters active users, groups them by department, and returns a deterministic object whose department keys are sorted. Include types and handle empty input.

scenarios.title: Review keyset pagination
scenarios.prompt: Given an Orders table with a unique increasing Id and CreatedAt timestamp, write a parameterized SQL Server query for the next page ordered by CreatedAt then Id. Explain why the cursor must include both values and mention an index that supports it.
scenarios.expectedOutput: Parameterized query and concise explanation; context only.

scenarios.title: Write accessible release notes
scenarios.prompt: Create a compact Markdown release-note section for a desktop app feature that adds keyboard navigation and a searchable settings page. Include a heading, user-facing changes, and one known limitation. Use clear, accessible wording.

scenarios.title: Analyze a resource-lifetime bug
scenarios.prompt: Analyze this C# code for correctness problems and propose a fix: static async Task<string> Fetch(HttpClient client, string url) { var response = await client.GetAsync(url); return await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(); } Address cancellation, unsuccessful status codes, and resource ownership without disposing the injected client.
scenarios.expectedOutput: Analysis and corrected code; context only.

scenarios.title: Propose a focused refactor
scenarios.prompt: Propose a minimal refactor for a method that validates an input string, reads a local JSON file, parses it, and returns a result. Show a C# method signature and explain how cancellation, malformed JSON, and I/O errors should be handled. Do not introduce a new dependency.

scenarios.title: Generate a small validation helper
scenarios.prompt: Generate a C# helper for validating a positive page size with a configurable upper bound. Include XML documentation and two short examples of expected behavior. Keep the helper dependency-free.
scenarios.expectedOutput: A small documented C# helper; context only.

scenarios.title: Use simulated code-search tools
scenarios.prompt: You are reviewing a small code change. First search for the referenced API, then run the relevant focused tests, and finally summarize the findings. Use the available tools when helpful.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search the codebase for a symbol. This is simulated and performs no I/O.
tools.simulatedResponse: Simulated search result: the API is declared in the sample service and called by its view model. No files were accessed.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run a named test filter. This is simulated and executes no process.
tools.simulatedResponse: Simulated test result: 5 passed, 0 failed. No tests were actually executed.

scenarios.expectedOutput: A short summary after zero or more simulated tool calls; context only.
